cristal-den/bibins-potiok-assassination.title: Wiping out the Potioks
cristal-den/bibins-potiok-assassination.description: Bibin wants the Potiok family gone: the Matriarch and each of her heirs. Once it is done, report to him.
cristal-den/bibins-potiok-assassination.kill-trout: Kill Trout Potiok, the newly named heir
cristal-den/bibins-potiok-assassination.desc-trout-heir: The Matriarch has named Trout Potiok her heir, so Bibin wants him dead like the rest. Bibin does not know that "Trout" is really Petiole, a changeling: only you and the hive do. Killing Petiole is the only way to kill Trout.
cristal-den/bibins-potiok-assassination.desc-trout-dead: "Trout" is dead: Petiole, the changeling wearing his face, was killed. As far as Bibin can tell, the last of the Potioks is gone.
